questions.question: Which retroperitoneal compartment contains the pancreas, the duodenal loop, and the ascending/descending colon?
questions.detail: The anterior pararenal space is bounded by the posterior parietal peritoneum and the anterior renal (Gerota’s) fascia.

questions.question: The "Perirenal space" is uniquely characterized by containing which of the following structures?
choices: A. The adrenal glands and kidneys
questions.detail: This space is enclosed by the anterior (Gerota’s) and posterior (Zuckerkandl’s) renal fasciae.

questions.question: In the setting of retroperitoneal fluid or masses, which finding helps localize pathology to the "Posterior pararenal space"?
choices: A. Anterior displacement of the kidneys
B. Preservation of the psoas muscle margin
C. Absence of major organs within the space
questions.detail: The posterior pararenal space contains only fat and some blood vessels; identifying fluid here that does not displace the kidney anteriorly helps localize the lesion.

questions.question: Lateral displacement of the ureters on an IVP or CT is most characteristic of:
questions.detail: Bulky retroperitoneal nodes typically displace the ureters laterally, whereas retroperitoneal fibrosis tends to pull them medially.
